title: ULTRON evidence-based blocker closure plan

known_report_inconsistencies.evidence: ATLAS_ARCHITECTURE_EXPLORER_VALIDATION.md states filesystem checks occurred on 2026-10-28, later than this plan's current session date 2026-10-27. The referenced Atlas cache timestamp 2026-10-27T13:02:33Z is earlier and must not be conflated with that future-dated check.
known_report_inconsistencies.resolution_required: Record provenance/correct the report date before relying on its filesystem checks as current.

known_report_inconsistencies.evidence: ULTRON_DEPENDENCY_SECURITY_REVIEW.md says CVE-2026-5241 does not list transformers 4.57.6; ULTRON_COMPREHENSIVE_LIMITATION_AUDIT.md and LIM-012 also cite GHSA-29pf-2h5f-8g72/CVE-2026-4372 and another GHSA range that includes 4.57.6. Different identifiers/ranges are cited; neither a blanket vulnerability nor blanket clearance is proven.
known_report_inconsistencies.resolution_required: Reconcile exact advisory IDs, affected ranges, package origin/version and actual reference-staging loader reachability.

known_report_inconsistencies.evidence: The comprehensive audit and LIM-012 cite three high pypdf advisories for selected-environment version 6.20.0 with 6.21.2 listed fixed; the specialized dependency review notes pypdf but does not include that advisory assessment. Root requirements are unpinned and production package identity is unknown.
known_report_inconsistencies.resolution_required: Include pypdf in the exact runtime lock/SBOM review; do not infer production exposure from the selected environment.

known_report_inconsistencies.evidence: The inventory/runbook describe persisted scene-gallery delivery. Current CRE_STATUS returns persisted scene metadata without dataBase64; renderCreAudioEvidence.js displays metadata only. operator-console.js renders dataBase64 returned by the preview action.
known_report_inconsistencies.resolution_required: Product owner must confirm whether persistent pixels are required; if yes, approve a bounded authenticated owner-scoped retrieval contract and add integration tests.

known_report_inconsistencies.evidence: ULTRON_COMPREHENSIVE_LIMITATION_AUDIT.md says no tests ran for that audit; recovery/release reports quote earlier isolated runs. This is compatible by scope but must not be presented as a fresh result for this closure plan.
known_report_inconsistencies.resolution_required: Re-run qualifying suites against the exact restored release and record command, date, counts, skips and failures.

parallelizable.condition: Use temporary databases only; do not touch live database paths.
Release-scope analysis must not change source or use live runtime state.

dependency_rationale: The original manager owner and source provenance must be understood before any proposed live maintenance; the source has no supported live adoption or handoff.
The exact release scope determines which dependencies, licenses, schemas, configs and runtime assets must be locked and reviewed.
License/advisory approval and CRE product-contract decisions must precede allowlist finalization because they can change the files and capabilities in the candidate release.
Temporary WAL-mode backup/restore qualification can be performed independently, but does not qualify a live backup.
Candidate and rollback artifacts must be built and restored before running release-bound regression tests.
Isolated end-to-end verification is meaningful only against a specific restored candidate and approved CRE contract.
Live maintenance requires all source, rollback, backup, test and operator-authorization gates; live authenticated acceptance follows the separately authorized maintenance.

requirements: Authenticated evidence of original manager owner/terminal or equivalent owner-controlled startup record.

Fresh read-only identity tuples for manager and every managed service: PID, process start ticks, executable real path, cwd, command identity, process group, parentage, state-record association, and listener binding/owner.
Reliable source/release provenance for the manager already in memory; current file hashes, timestamps, PID or port alone do not attest loaded code.
Documented supported control/shutdown path through the original owner. No unvalidated adoption or competing manager.
Release-owner-approved exact source/runtime allowlist and dependency lock/SBOM.
Candidate archive and independently justified rollback archive pass exact-member, SHA-256, CRC/integrity and separate restore checks.
Temporary WAL-mode online-backup/restore rehearsal passes integrity, schema/version, size, hash, permission and source/WAL preservation checks.

For any later live backup: explicit operator authorization, expected schema/application/user version, protected owner-only destination, recorded timestamp, verified online backup and separate restore.
Explicit authorization names exact release and rollback IDs/hashes, affected services/databases, window, change steps and post-checks.
Secret-free maintenance journal and stop/rollback plan are ready.
stop_conditions: Manager owner, loaded source identity or original terminal is unknown or disputed.
Any process PID/start identity, executable, cwd, command, process group, parentage, listener owner or state record is stale or ambiguous.
Unexpected listener, stale state, missing ownership evidence, absent supported shutdown route or failed control channel.
Missing/unverified candidate or rollback archive, dependency/license decision, backup, restore, schema, integrity, hash or required test.
Any request to adopt, signal, restart, alter databases, broaden scope, publish, trade, access OMEGA or expose credentials.
recovery_gate.on_failure: Set status to INTERVENTION_REQUIRED, preserve the current stack and records, and do not signal, stop, restart, adopt, repair state artifacts or deploy.

missions.title: Resolve runtime ownership and identity
missions.objective: Establish who owns the existing manager, identify the recorded services and determine whether reliable launch-time source/release provenance and a supported original-owner control path exist.
scope: Operator-led read-only manager/service identity capture.
Inspect original manager terminal/session or authenticated startup/ownership records.
Compare manager/service command, executable, cwd, process start identity, process group, parentage, state records and listener ownership.
Report loaded-source association as UNKNOWN when direct provenance is absent.
explicit_exclusions: No signal, stop, restart, adoption, handoff, second manager, lease/socket creation/deletion, or service-state edit.
No live database, credential, or unrelated runtime access.
tests_and_acceptance: No automated unit test can establish ownership of the live manager.
Accept only owner-controlled startup evidence plus identity-matched current process records and a documented supported control path.
If any identity/source/owner fact remains ambiguous, classify INTERVENTION_REQUIRED and stop.
missions.recovery_or_rollback: Preserve the running stack, supervision and state records. No rollback operation is authorized.
evidence_required_for_closure: Timestamped sanitized identity tuple for manager and all four recorded services.
Original manager owner/terminal or authenticated owner audit evidence.
Release/source provenance or explicit UNKNOWN result.
Operator confirmation of any state-directory lifecycle action.
operator_blockers: Responsible operator must identify/confirm owner and provide approved read-only access to ownership evidence.
If original owner/terminal cannot be found, intervention by the system owner is required.

missions.title: Approve exact release scope
missions.objective: Identify the intended source snapshot and close all runtime-required files, configs, entrypoints, package data, schemas, migrations and dynamic/script-loaded resources.
scope: Release owner selects exact source/release identity and service contract.
Build an explicit file allowlist and dependency/resource closure.
Record required optional assets and intentionally excluded environments.
likely_files_to_change: A future approved release file list and release manifest.
Potentially docs/ULTRON_RELEASE_MANIFEST.json in a separately authorized documentation task.
explicit_exclusions: Do not treat the scoped 14-file baseline or any arbitrary ZIP as deployable or known-good.
Exclude credentials, .env files, live databases/WAL/SHM, caches, virtual environments and unrelated generated files.
Do not delete or classify Atlas's 370 environment candidates as unused.
tests_and_acceptance: Review import, script, service, configuration, plugin, package-data and schema closure.
Every included path has a rationale/hash; every uncertain runtime dependency blocks closure or is explicitly resolved.
Allowlist is approved by the release owner.
missions.recovery_or_rollback: Preserve current source and all pre-existing archives; do not overwrite or rename artifacts.
evidence_required_for_closure: Signed or otherwise authenticated release-owner approval of source identity and allowlist.
Exact exclusion list and runtime file/dependency closure record.
operator_blockers: Release owner must define and approve intended release scope.

missions.title: Resolve dependency and license gates
missions.objective: Produce the supported-runtime lock/SBOM and resolve PyMuPDF licensing, pypdf advisory status, and exact Transformers advisory applicability.
scope: Resolve PyMuPDF AGPL compliance or commercial-license decision for actual deployment/distribution.
Resolve exact pypdf version and advisory applicability for the intended runtime.
Reconcile Transformers advisory IDs/ranges separately and trace reference-staging model-loader paths.
Keep managed Edge and optional XTTS environments distinct.
likely_files_to_change: A versioned dependency lock and SBOM for the selected runtime.
Possibly requirements.txt or a separate optional dependency manifest after a separate implementation approval.
explicit_exclusions: No package install or upgrade in this planning mission.
Do not remove or replace PyMuPDF without legal and behavior-compatibility review.
Do not declare Transformers 4.57.6 categorically vulnerable or clear based on a different advisory.
tests_and_acceptance: Exact installed/locked versions match SBOM and target platform.
Advisories are listed by ID, version range, package origin and reachable call path.
Legal/compliance decision is recorded.
missions.recovery_or_rollback: Any later dependency change must retain a prior approved lock and rebuild/requalify a new release candidate.
evidence_required_for_closure: Signed legal/compliance disposition for PyMuPDF.
Resolved lock/SBOM for required runtime and separately classified optional environments.
Advisory applicability table and loader-reachability evidence.
operator_blockers: Legal/compliance owner must decide license applicability or approve a commercial license.
Release owner must approve supported runtime scope and dependency versions.

missions.title: Approve CRE capability and image contract
missions.objective: Define the approved local CRE verification scope and decide whether the dashboard must display persisted scene image bytes or only persisted evidence metadata.
scope: Confirm authenticated CRE status and synthetic local preview as the current supported workflow.
Specify status freshness, stale/error behavior, preview state, evidence hashes, dimensions and image-decode requirements.
Decide whether a new owner-scoped persisted-image retrieval contract is required.
Keep processing, publishing and analytics states unavailable unless separately implemented.
likely_files_to_change: No files if current preview-only boundary is accepted.

If persistent pixels are required: likely gateway/CRE asset retrieval implementation, frontend contracts/provider and operator-console renderer, plus focused tests; exact changes require approved design.
explicit_exclusions: No media discovery/fetching, external publishing, revenue claims, rights-policy weakening, OMEGA, or trading changes.
No assumption that current status metadata already renders persisted image pixels.
tests_and_acceptance: Contract covers authenticated owner scope, payload bounds, hash/dimension bindings, image tamper and decode failures.
Unavailable processing, preview-only rendering, mock-only publishing and unavailable analytics remain explicit.
missions.recovery_or_rollback: If future code is approved, keep changes isolated and revertible; fallback remains metadata/status and clearly labeled preview-only behavior.
evidence_required_for_closure: Written CRE product-owner decision on persisted image delivery.
Rights-policy boundary and approved synthetic fixture.
operator_blockers: CRE/product owner must approve capability scope.
Rights-policy owner must approve the synthetic preview policy.

missions.title: Rehearse isolated SQLite recovery
missions.objective: Freshly qualify the existing online SQLite backup and separate restore flow using only temporary WAL-mode fixtures.
scope: Create a temporary WAL-mode database with known schema/user/application versions.
Use scripts/ultron_sqlite_backup.py online backup, verification and restore APIs.
Record source/WAL preservation, owner-only permissions, integrity, schema, size, timestamp and SHA-256.
likely_files_to_change: None if current utility and tests pass.
If a defect is found, narrowly scoped changes to scripts/ultron_sqlite_backup.py and tests/runtime/test_sqlite_backup.py require a separate implementation mission.
explicit_exclusions: Never use a live ULTRON database path.
No live open, copy, checkpoint, migration, backup, restore or mutation.
tests_and_acceptance: Run tests/runtime/test_sqlite_backup.py against temporary fixtures.
Verify 0700 backup directory, 0600 backup/manifest, integrity_check=ok, expected schema/application/user versions, size and digest.
Restore to a separate destination and verify schema/integrity; source DB and WAL remain unchanged.
missions.recovery_or_rollback: Use and clean only test-owned temporary artifacts; preserve fixture source until comparisons complete.
evidence_required_for_closure: Fresh command output with pass/fail/skip counts.
Sanitized fixture manifest and before/after source/WAL checksums.

missions.title: Build candidate and rollback artifacts
missions.objective: Create reproducible candidate and independently justified known-good rollback archives using exact approved file lists.
scope: Build with scripts/ultron_release_bundle.py.
Verify exact archive members, per-file hashes, archive SHA-256, integrity and allowlist.
Restore candidate and rollback to separate new directories and verify all restored files.
Run import/startup/configuration checks only on isolated restored candidate.
likely_files_to_change: Approved release allowlist and signed release/rollback manifests.
explicit_exclusions: No deployment.
No arbitrary ZIP relabeling or use of the 14-file baseline as rollback.
No credentials, live DB/WAL/SHM, venv/cache, or unapproved reference environment.
tests_and_acceptance: Run tests/runtime/test_release_bundle.py.
Same input produces reproducible bytes; tampering is rejected; member set exactly equals manifest.
Candidate and independently known-good rollback restore to separate paths and match per-file hashes.
If a trustworthy known-good rollback source cannot be established, leave gate NO-GO.
missions.recovery_or_rollback: Keep original archives/source untouched; only restore into fresh isolated destinations.
evidence_required_for_closure: Release and rollback IDs, archive hashes, manifests, exact file lists, restore hashes and test output.
Release-owner approval binding artifacts to the intended source snapshot.
operator_blockers: Release owner must identify and approve a genuinely known-good rollback source.

missions.title: Qualify exact restored candidate
missions.objective: Run focused and required broader regressions against the exact restored candidate and pinned dependency environment.
scope: Service manager and maintenance ownership tests.
Authentication helper, gateway authorization, CRE status/preview, System Intelligence and persistence tests.
Release/SQLite tests and frontend suite.
Record optional-dependency collection errors, safety guards and product failures separately.
explicit_exclusions: No live service/database calls, credentials, trading/order submission, publishing, OMEGA requests, or assertion weakening.
Do not run an unbounded suite if it may touch live systems; confirm simulation and fixture isolation.
tests_and_acceptance: Fresh exact command, counts, skips, failures and environment recorded for every required suite.
No test failure is suppressed; safety guards remain enabled.
Results are tied to the candidate release ID/hash and dependency lock.
missions.recovery_or_rollback: Any source/dependency change invalidates this qualification and requires a rebuilt candidate and rerun.
evidence_required_for_closure: Machine-readable test result summary bound to release hash.
Static/import diagnostics scope and unresolved optional-dependency classification.
operator_blockers: Release owner approves any change to the intended tested release.

missions.title: Verify isolated authenticated CRE end to end
missions.objective: Exercise the candidate helper, authenticated gateway, CRE status and synthetic local preview in an isolated browser/test stack.
scope: Use temporary CRE database, isolated ports, synthetic local script and test identities.
Verify fresh CRE status, preview generation, backend/front-end contract, hash and dimensions.
If approved and implemented, independently verify authenticated persisted-image retrieval.
Verify stale/error, reconnect and owner-isolation fixtures.
likely_files_to_change: Existing tests/interface/test_interface_gateway_cre_status.py and interface/tests/* CRE/provider/render tests if gaps are found.
An isolated browser harness only if approved and required by existing project test patterns.
Any implementation changes must be separately reviewed and added to a new candidate.
explicit_exclusions: No production credentials/data or live services.
No external media fetch, publishing, trading or OMEGA.
Fixture owner-isolation does not establish live second-principal isolation.
tests_and_acceptance: Synthetic preview has correlated authenticated response and explicitly unverified rights/review/publication state.
Scene asset hash, byte size, format, manifest/contract bindings and dimensions agree with backend evidence.
Every displayed image decodes in the browser with naturalWidth>0 and naturalHeight>0.
Stale/unavailable/unauthorized errors remain visible; owner A cannot read owner B fixture data.
missions.recovery_or_rollback: Isolated processes and temporary data only; tear down only resources created by the test and preserve sanitized evidence.
evidence_required_for_closure: Release-bound test output.
Sanitized browser console/error summary and freshness timestamps.
Per-image backend/displayed hash, dimensions and decode result.
Separate fixture label and cross-owner denial result.
operator_blockers: Product owner approval for persisted-image delivery if required.
Live owner-isolation remains gated on a separately authorized second principal.

missions.title: Authorize live recovery preflight
missions.objective: Prepare a separately approved live maintenance window only after all isolated release, rollback, backup and test gates pass.
scope: Recheck live identity using read-only methods immediately before maintenance.
Obtain explicit authorization for any live online backup and perform only under the future authorized task.
Review original-owner-supported service control path and durable journal.
likely_files_to_change: Protected external backup and maintenance journal artifacts only under separate authorization.
explicit_exclusions: This plan does not authorize or execute live database access/backup, signals, stop/restart, adoption/handoff or deployment.
tests_and_acceptance: Every recovery_gate requirement passes with evidence.
Any ambiguity or failed restore/test returns to NO-GO/INTERVENTION_REQUIRED.
Authorization names exact release/rollback IDs, data paths, services, time window and stop conditions.
missions.recovery_or_rollback: On any mismatch, preserve current services/state and stop; do not repair ownership artifacts or attempt a new manager.
evidence_required_for_closure: Operator-approved maintenance plan and exact scope.
Read-only process/source identity record.
Protected backup and separate restore verification if live backup is authorized.
Journal and rollback plan.
operator_blockers: Responsible operator must authorize exact live inspection/backup scope.
Original manager owner must confirm supported control path.

missions.title: Execute separately authorized maintenance
missions.objective: Carry out only an operator-approved maintenance/deployment plan against the exact verified candidate and recovery point.
scope: Separate future task with exact approved service, release and data scope.
Run prechecks, approved action, postchecks and maintenance journal.
explicit_exclusions: No implicit authority for voice, trading, publishing, OMEGA or unrelated services.
No manager adoption or signal if current owner/identity is ambiguous.
tests_and_acceptance: Runtime identity matches approved release/source.
Only planned service identities change; unrelated services remain unchanged if action is scoped.
Required service readiness, authentication and recovery checks pass.
missions.recovery_or_rollback: Use only the verified approved rollback bundle and protected database restore procedure.
evidence_required_for_closure: Operator-signed maintenance journal, release hashes, process identities, readiness and test results.
operator_blockers: Explicit operator approval for the maintenance window and exact operations.

missions.title: Verify authenticated live acceptance
missions.objective: After the separately authorized maintenance, verify current authenticated gateway and CRE/dashboard behavior without handling credentials outside the private UI.
scope: Use normal local unlock UI; operator privately enters credential.

Verify authenticated gateway, current status timestamps, stale/error behavior, CRE synthetic preview if separately authorized, actual persisted-gallery path if implemented, reconnect and browser console.
Use a second authorized principal before making a live owner-isolation claim.
likely_files_to_change: Separate sanitized operator verification record only.
explicit_exclusions: No credentials in chat, shell, logs or screenshots.
No direct unauthenticated gateway, publishing, trading, database mutation, OMEGA access or service restart.
tests_and_acceptance: Follow docs/ULTRON_AUTHENTICATED_VERIFICATION_RUNBOOK.md.
UI status is tied to fresh backend response and correct release identity.
Every displayed image decodes with nonzero dimensions and matches current backend hash/dimensions.
Owner-isolation claim is omitted unless a second authorized principal is used.
missions.recovery_or_rollback: Stop on identity, auth, freshness, image-integrity or authorization mismatch; report actual state and use no unapproved recovery action.
evidence_required_for_closure: Sanitized timestamped browser record tied to release identity.
Status/freshness/error and reconnect results.
Per-image backend/display hashes, dimensions and decode result.
Console summary and authorized principal labels only.
operator_blockers: Authorized second principal required for live owner-isolation verification.

deferred_capabilities.closure_condition: Separate owner-approved mission defines lawful intake, rights, model/assets, bounded processing, cancellation/recovery, owner scope, UI/error states and tests.
Separate mission and explicit authorization for provider integration, protected credentials, approval/rights/kill-switch, durable external-operation recovery and sandbox/live acceptance.
Approved source, attribution, time range, freshness and error contract plus tests; no revenue inference from preview/review/upload state.
No cleanup proposed. Any later candidate-specific change requires independent dynamic/script/plugin/config/recovery evidence.

first_actionable_blocker.action: Have the responsible operator identify the original manager owner/terminal and supply read-only evidence for current manager/service identities and launch-time source provenance.

safe_engineering_work_after_operator_gat: Run SQLite online-backup/restore rehearsal against temporary WAL-mode databases only.
Resolve approved file closure and dependency/license/advisory inventory without changing the live runtime.
Test candidate release bundle creation, verification and restoration in isolated directories.
Run candidate-bound simulation, gateway/auth/CRE, persistence and frontend tests.
Resolve and, only after product approval, implement the authenticated owner-scoped persisted-image retrieval contract.
Run an isolated temporary-DB/browser end-to-end synthetic preview test with fixture identities.
final_rule: No plan artifact or unit test passes a gate by itself. Deployment remains NO-GO until each applicable gate has direct, release-bound evidence and the operator explicitly authorizes the exact maintenance operation.
